<thought>Based on the isotopic pattern, a +2 Da peak at ~24 % relative intensity matches the characteristic ^35Cl/^37Cl ratio (≈3:1). No other element shows a definitive pattern (e.g., Br would be 1:1, S much smaller). Thus chlorine is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['Cl']</final_answer>
